title: Suggestion for improvement: many duplicate B.G. values to delete with one click
body: This might be very easy to implement. If there are 2-3 duplicate values, it is easy to remove them, but if there are 36 duplicates it needs much time. I suggest “Remove” button for all duplicates.

comments.body: Multi select delete is implemented in de dev branch. #1437
One click would be much better.
